11. remove build cache
12. `DIR_TO_GLEAM/gleam/target/release/gleam test --target=javascript` --> succeeds
Thank you

def parser(log: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    import re
    from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

    results: dict[str, str] = {}

    # 1) Strip ANSI escape sequences for colored output
    ansi_re = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]")
    log = ansi_re.sub("", log).replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")

    # Helper to record status with simple precedence:
    # fail overrides pass/skip; pass overrides unset; skip overrides unset.
    def record(name: str, status: str) -> None:
        if not name:
            return
        name = name.strip()
        if not name:
            return
        prev = results.get(name)
        if prev == "fail":
            return
        if status == "fail":
            results[name] = "fail"
            return
        if prev is None:
            results[name] = status
            return
        if prev == "skip" and status == "pass":
            results[name] = "pass"

    # 2) Attempt JUnit-style XML extraction if present anywhere in the log
    # (some runners print XML to stdout/stderr).
    if "<testsuite" in log and "<testcase" in log:
        # Try parsing each <testsuite ...>...</testsuite> block
        for m in re.finditer(r"(<testsuite\b[\s\S]*?</testsuite>)", log):
            block = m.group(1)
            try:
                root = ET.fromstring(block)
            except Exception:
                continue

            def iter_testcases(elem):
                for tc in elem.iter():
                    if tc.tag.endswith("testcase"):
                        yield tc

            for tc in iter_testcases(root):
                classname = tc.attrib.get("classname", "")
                tname = tc.attrib.get("name", "")
                full = (classname + "::" + tname).strip("::") if classname else tname
                status = "pass"
                for child in list(tc):
                    tag = child.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
                    if tag in ("failure", "error"):
                        status = "fail"
                        break
                    if tag == "skipped":
                        status = "skip"
                record(full, status)

    # 3) Line-oriented parsing for common test frameworks
    # Rust libtest:
    #   test path::name ... ok
    #   test path::name ... FAILED
    #   test path::name ... ignored
    rust_test_line = re.compile(
        r"^\s*test\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s+\.\.\.\s+(?P<status>ok|FAILED|ignored|bench)\s*$"
    )
    # Rust libtest alternative failures sometimes show as:
    #   test name ... FAILED (signal: 11, SIGSEGV: invalid memory reference)
    rust_test_line2 = re.compile(
        r"^\s*test\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s+\.\.\.\s+(?P<status>FAILED|ignored|ok)\b.*$"
    )
    # Rust doc tests sometimes:
    #   test crate/src/lib.rs - some::path (line 12) ... ok
    rust_doctest = re.compile(
        r"^\s*test\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s+\(line\s+\d+\)\s+\.\.\.\s+(?P<status>ok|FAILED|ignored)\b.*$"
    )
    # Go test:
    go_line = re.compile(r"^\s*---\s+(?P<status>PASS|FAIL|SKIP):\s+(?P<name>\S+)\b.*$")
    # pytest:
    pytest_line = re.compile(
        r"^(?P<name>.+?::.+?)\s+(?P<status>PASSED|FAILED|SKIPPED|XFAIL|XPASS|ERROR)\b.*$"
    )
    # unittest/nose style:
    #   TestClass.test_method ... ok/FAIL/ERROR/skipped
    unittest_line = re.compile(
        r"^\s*(?P<name>[A-Za-z_][\w\.]*\.[A-Za-z_][\w\.]*)\s+\.\.\.\s+"
        r"(?P<status>ok|OK|FAIL|FAILED|ERROR|SKIP|skipped)\b.*$"
    )
    # Jest-like:
    #   ✓ test name
    #   ✕ test name
    jest_symbol = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<sym>[✓✔]|✕|×|○)\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s*$")
    # Jest-like summary:
    #   PASS  path - testname
    #   FAIL  path - testname
    jest_passfail = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<status>PASS|FAIL)\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s*$")

    for line in log.splitlines():
        line = line.strip("\n")

        m = rust_test_line.match(line) or rust_doctest.match(line) or rust_test_line2.match(line)
        if m:
            name = m.group("name").strip()
            status = m.group("status")
            if status == "ok" or status == "bench":
                record(name, "pass")
            elif status == "ignored":
                record(name, "skip")
            else:
                record(name, "fail")
            continue

        m = go_line.match(line)
        if m:
            st = m.group("status")
            name = m.group("name")
            record(name, "pass" if st == "PASS" else ("skip" if st == "SKIP" else "fail"))
            continue

        m = pytest_line.match(line)
        if m:
            st = m.group("status")
            name = m.group("name")
            if st in ("PASSED",):
                record(name, "pass")
            elif st in ("SKIPPED", "XFAIL"):
                record(name, "skip")
            else:
                # FAILED, ERROR, XPASS => fail
                record(name, "fail")
            continue

        m = unittest_line.match(line)
        if m:
            st = m.group("status").lower()
            name = m.group("name")
            if st in ("ok", "ok."):
                record(name, "pass")
            elif st in ("skip", "skipped"):
                record(name, "skip")
            else:
                record(name, "fail")
            continue

        m = jest_symbol.match(line)
        if m:
            sym = m.group("sym")
            name = m.group("name").strip()
            if sym in ("✓", "✔"):
                record(name, "pass")
            elif sym == "○":
                record(name, "skip")
            else:
                record(name, "fail")
            continue

        m = jest_passfail.match(line)
        if m:
            st = m.group("status")
            name = m.group("name").strip()
            record(name, "pass" if st == "PASS" else "fail")
            continue

    return results
